title: VIXEN configure preset resolves only from its subdirectory
body: Running cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the worktree root exited 1 because CMakePresets.json is under VIXEN. Re-running from VIXEN completed configuration. Add a root forwarding preset or a root-safe documented entry point.

title: Box queue wrapper lookup depends on the current directory
body: Running the required bash tools/with-test-lock.sh command from VIXEN exited 127 because the script is at the worktree root; the same queued test passed from the worktree root. Provide a root-resolving wrapper path for VIXEN subdirectory callers.

title: Codegen does not discover the project kernel checkout
body: The VIXEN codegen probe looks for ~/Github/Yeroket-Fantasy while this authorized checkout is /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy, so each standalone historical configure needed -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy. Discover the active project checkout or accept a stable documented environment setting.

title: Pinned kernel snapshots need a worktree-local cache setting
body: To keep the exact b8 and e9 snapshots inside the assigned worktree, standalone configure commands passed -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR=<worktree>/.tmp/cornellseam/kernel-cache; the default helper writes under ~/.cache. Provide a worktree-local preset or helper so isolated lanes do not need to select the cache manually.

title: Historical VIXEN builds need a reusable FetchContent cache path
body: The queued configure and build commands explicitly set VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/.tmp/fetch to reuse provisioned sources across the 61df and 1529073e source snapshots. Expose a documented history-build helper or stable worktree cache option so endpoint checks do not need this repeated environment setup.

title: Archived VIXEN source trees need an explicit Vulkan SDK cache path
body: Each archived endpoint configure passed -DVIXEN_VULKAN_CACHE_DIR=<worktree>/VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk so both snapshots reused the single provisioned SDK. Provide a documented cache-reuse option for isolated source snapshots to avoid manually redirecting SDK provisioning.
